# Confirm keyboard draft recovery stays safe after repeated view changes

## What & Why
The current regression coverage checks one trip to the other view before an exact-deadline keyboard activation. Repeated navigation can expose state or focus regressions that a single switch misses.

## Done looks like
- Answer and opportunity recovery notices survive multiple alternating view changes.
- Enter and Space at the exact deadline still do not open either form.
- The existing no-longer-available announcements remain intact.
